title: See Financial Data toggle appears in the Cross-Cutting Toggles card
custom_preconds:
1. Log in as an Administrator.
  2. Open Roles & Permissions and start Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps:
1. Scroll to the bottom of the permissions area.
  2. Find the card titled Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Read the first toggle's name.
  4. Find its on/off switch.
custom_expected:
A card titled Cross-Cutting Toggles is shown.

The first toggle is named See Financial Data.

The toggle has an on/off switch on the right.

Note: the small grey text under this toggle currently repeats the Work orders description ('Manage work orders the core operational records in ShopView.') — this looks like a leftover placeholder and should be flagged to the team.
evidence: Card 'Cross-Cutting Toggles' + toggle 'See Financial Data' confirmed in shipped build (CrossTogglesSection chunk). Reused subtitle string flagged.
